assets.alt_text: Citta connects your laptop and another device for task handoff. Four reasons: private files, installed tools, connected hardware and spare compute.
Ask from a Mac mini; the MacBook Air reads its synthetic receipts and returns an expense report. The real report identifies a duplicate and a missing receipt.
Reverse handoff: the MacBook Air uses Gemma 3 4B through Ollama on the Mini to categorize six synthetic expenses. Inference is local; Codex orchestration is cloud-backed.

Start with two computers: connect Tailscale under the same owner, install Citta on each and run setup and doctor, then ask for a small remote task. Each device needs the tools, accounts and permissions for its part.
Citta mark: two open concentric arcs in green on a charcoal square.
